subject: Generation-10 saturation pass: every named organ needs an execution witness or bounded block

body.objective: Turn the architecture map from a catalog into an executable coverage graph. Named-but-never-exercised is coverage debt.
owner_families: EffectKernel + Restate + AgentSession + WorkerRun + Bernstein + celld + ProtocolMachine
ObjectFabric + BLAKE3 + Zstd + OpenDAL + Iroh + QUIC + Format Commons
ReceiptEnvelope + WitnessDAG + EvidenceGraph + DSSE + SARIF + VEX + OTel
ProofBundle + ProofFrontier + SolvedInvariant + KnownNonCause + RegressionFence + FactorValidityEnvelope + DeletionProof
body.required_artifact: Emit an executable coverage matrix keyed by named owner/organ with states exercised_real, exercised_replay, blocked_external, blocked_resource, dormant_bug, or redundant_by_proof. Each exercised state must point to a receipt/proof; each blocked state must name the exact missing authority/resource/provider/input.
body.anti_demo_rule: Do not satisfy coverage with importability, unit construction, mocked calls, or isolated toy demos when a bounded real path exists.
body.resource_rule: Use tiny fixtures and existing installed providers/assets. Do not download large models or regenerate heavyweight corpora merely to mark coverage.
